name: Entur Transit
description: Norway-wide transit stops, boards, routes, trip planning, alerts, vehicles, and stop facilities via Entur

dataSources.purpose: Search Norwegian transit stops, fetch stop boards, line details, route sequences, realtime journeys, service alerts, live vehicles, and stop-facility metadata via Entur's public APIs
dataSources.dataSent: Coordinates, stop IDs, line IDs, service-journey IDs, time windows, optional Norway boundary filter, multimodal stop mode, ET-Client-Name header
dataSources.dataReceived: Journey Planner GraphQL stops, lines, trip patterns, estimated calls, service situations, encoded leg geometries, realtime vehicle positions, NSR stop accessibility/equipment/parking data
